install.windows_download: Open https://kilo.ai/install and select the Windows x64 or ARM64 .exe matching this machine. Save it to the user's Downloads directory and open the installer.
install.macos_download: Open https://kilo.ai/install and download the Apple Silicon .dmg. Kilo Desktop currently has no official Intel macOS download. Open the disk image and let the user install Kilo.app.
install.linux_download: Open https://kilo.ai/install and download the x64 or ARM64 .deb matching this machine. Install the downloaded Debian package using the system package installer.
install.note: Official Kilo Desktop by Anaconda. Its executable is kilo-desktop, with a bundled Kilo CLI. Gateway accounts share the Kilo auth store, while Desktop model preferences are separate from CLI defaults. Do not install Kiro or OpenCode as a substitute.

install_flow.summary: Detect platform/architecture, download the matching official installer, open it, and verify Kilo Desktop is detected.
agent_steps: Detect OS and CPU architecture first.
Select the matching download from https://kilo.ai/install. For an Intel Mac, report that no official Desktop package is available; the Kilo CLI remains available.
Save the installer to Downloads and tell the user its exact full path.
Open the installer with Start-Process on Windows or open on macOS; use the package installer for the Linux .deb.
Let the user finish the native installation, then refresh detection. Do not automate installer GUI steps.
tell_user: How to finish the native installer
Kilo Desktop and Kilo CLI share login credentials but use separate model preferences

first_run.description: Launch Kilo Desktop and sign in to the Kilo Gateway account, or add a custom AI provider in AI settings.
